name: claude-account-switcher
description: Multi-account Claude Code: the claude-account CLI plugin (bash, macOS + Linux) alongside Claude Switcher.app (macOS menu bar). Both share one store under ~/.claude/accounts.

plugins.name: claude-account
plugins.description: Switch between Claude Code subscription accounts without re-login. Snapshots each login, swaps the live one in under a second, and hops to the next account when the 5h quota runs out. Runs where the .app cannot: Linux, VPS, any shell.
